name: PDF Viewer & Editor
shortDescription: Open, annotate, edit, and download PDF documents locally in your browser.
description: Open a PDF from your device and use the supported viewing, annotation, form, signature, and page-editing tools. Save changes through your browser's download flow. Documents are processed locally; the extension does not send document contents to a remote service.

privacyDisclosure.dataCollection: No analytics or personal data collection.
privacyDisclosure.documentProcessing: PDFs selected by the user are processed locally in the extension.
privacyDisclosure.localStorage: Preferences, recent-file metadata, and autosave data remain in browser-local storage.

permissions.downloads: Save the edited PDF through the browser download manager.
permissions.contextMenus: Add an explicit menu item to open a selected PDF in the editor.
